subject: Computação
description_pt: Conhecer os componentes básicos de dispositivos computacionais, entendendo os princípios de seu funcionamento.

components.description_pt: Identificar componentes básicos de hardware de dispositivo computacional
components.description_en: Identify the basic hardware components of a computing device (e.g., processor, memory, storage, input/output)
components.cc_component_description: Identify the components of a defined system and describe their roles

components.description_pt: Explicar função de cada componente básico na operação de dispositivo computacional
components.description_en: Explain the function of each basic component in the operation of a computing device
components.cc_component_description: Explain how the relationships among component parts affect the overall function of a system

components.description_pt: Descrever como componentes de hardware trabalham juntos para processar e exibir informações
components.description_en: Describe how hardware components work together to process and display information
components.cc_component_description: Explain how parts of a system work together to achieve a system-level function

cc_matches.description: Complex and microscopic structures and systems can be visualized, modeled, and used to describe how their function depends on the shapes, composition, and relationships among its parts, therefore complex natural structures/systems can be analyzed to determine how they function.
Systems in the natural and designed world have parts that work together.
A system can be described in terms of its components and their interactions.
